name: true402 swap guard
description: Blocks token buys when true402 finds a honeypot or a rug in progress (Base, Ethereum, BSC, Solana).

defaultChain.description: Chain assumed for a 0x address when the trade names none. Default base.

onCaution.description: On a 'caution' verdict: let the trade through (default) or ask you first.

onUnchecked.description: When a token could not be checked (API unreachable, free checks used up): allow (default), ask, or block.

timeoutMs.description: Give up on one check after this many ms (default 15000).

maxAmountUsd.description: Never pay more than this for one check, in USDC (default 0.02).

maxPaidChecksPerDay.description: At most this many paid checks per day; beyond it only free checks run (default 50).
